title: nan
authors: Matiki T.; Narazaki Y.; Chowdhary G.; Spencer B.F.
key_contribution: Proposes GBDTpose, a graphics-based digital twin framework for accurate UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, validated numerically (SITL) and in field tests on a bridge.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
